title: Command relief and eight billet assignments

paragraphs.text: Lieutenant Colonel C. E. MC PARTLIN, Jr., was re- lieved as Commanding Officer by Captain C. H. RAM. The following billets were filled on this date: S-1: First Lieutenant T. BOYD S-2: First Lieutenant E. A. KRATOVIL, Jr. S-4: Captain H. C. WINCH CO, H&SCo: First Lieutenant P. C. ROLLINS CO, "E"Co: First Lieutenant T. R. MINOR CO, "F"Co: First Lieutenant D. G. WINTER CO, "G"Co: First Lieutenant D. H. EERING CO, "H"Co: First Lieutenant J. J. DOHERTY
